name: Rocket Fuel - (5g) Baller Bucket - Super Boof
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Rocket Fuel Super Boof Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Super Boof is a standout hybrid born from crossing Black Cherry Punch with Tropicana Cookies, and the flavor delivers on both sides of that cross. Expect sweet dark cherry and berry notes up front, brightened by zesty citrus and finished with a subtly gassy, earthy edge. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a balanced, feel-good experience that brings an uplifting mood boost alongside easy body relaxation.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Super Boof flavor — sweet dark cherry and berry with zesty citrus and a gassy finish
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Super Boof is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
